objectives.title: Capture Points
objectives.description: Control points activate occasionally. Stand within them to capture them. Fully capturing a point grants you control of a giant mech.

objectives.title: Control the Protector
objectives.description: The Triglav Protector mech is controlled by two players: one pilot and one gunner. Work together!

objectives.title: Destroy Everything
objectives.description: The Protector's Abilities deal incredible damage to Structures and Heroes alike. Use it to lay waste to your enemy.
